name: Image Processor (WebP)
description: Convert images to WebP and to responsive .
project_description:
About Image Processor WebP 
 The Image Processor WebP module is a Drupal tool designed to simplify the image optimization process on websites by automatically converting all uploaded images to the WEBP format, which provides excellent compression and quality.

 Key Features 
 
 Automatically creates a WEBP copy of each JPG/PNG uploaded image. 
 HTML Modification: Scans the generated HTML page and replaces `img` tags with tags for enhanced browser support and adaptive image display. 
 
 Configuration Options 
 The module provides a backend interface for setting up: choice of image processing library (GD, ImageMagick, etc.), toggle for auto-conversion, and default formats and file extensions for different media types.
